saved.description: Settings: the status line after a setting is changed.

resetDefaults.description:

that names what a reset leaves behind. $count$ is how many redirectors a fresh install enables, $default$ the name of the one it makes the default. Both are read from the stored defaults rather than written out, so this sentence cannot go stale.

importUnreadable.message: That file could not be read as settings: $detail$

importNoneAtAll.description: Settings: shown when an imported file holds no redirectors the user could adopt.

savedImported.description: Settings: status line after settings are replaced from a file.

importAddedOne.description: Settings: the singular form of the status line after merging an import.

importNothingToAdd.description: Settings: status line when a merge brought nothing across.

checkInProgress.description: Settings: label on the Check button while a check is running.

customNeedName.description: Settings: shown when the custom redirector form is submitted with no name.
